verdict.rationale: Poke documents natural-language reminders, Recipes for setting up automations, and event-driven triggers from external services via its API. It also describes itself as a proactive assistant. None of this explicitly shows user-scheduled recurring or one-off agent tasks that run on their own and report results back. Missing for 10: explicit scheduled/recurring task execution (cron-like or 'every morning do X'), documentation of results being delivered back from scheduled runs, management of scheduled tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
